paragraphs: (Ammiel son of Gemalli, [Numbers 13:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Numbers.13.12).) Abba Elazar ben Gamla (a Tanna): [Gittin 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.30b.13); [Beitzah 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.13b.3) reads ben Gimel.
Rabbi Chanina ben Gamla: [Sanhedrin 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.111a.12) (and Hyman says it should read ben Gamliel there).[^2]

notes.text: The consulted passages have Gemalli in Numbers, Gamla in Gittin, Gimel in Beitzah and Chanina ben Gamla in Sanhedrin. Gamliel is Hyman’s proposed correction in Sanhedrin.

[Heilprin’s notice for Abba Elazar](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=559&lang=en) gives ben Gomel in its heading and records Gimel in Beitzah and Gamla in Gittin. Hyman’s Gamliel proposal concerns the separate Chanina notice.
